purpose: Preserve only useful geometric/mechanical relationships from the experimental carousel while restarting the visual design from scratch. This template must not be treated as a miniature, diorama, toy-like or chibi attraction.

scalePolicy.selectionRule: Choose the smallest footprint that preserves believable attraction scale, readable proportions, boarding space and gameplay clarity. Do not force 7x7 when a smaller footprint works, and do not compress the asset merely to fit a smaller footprint.
scalePolicy.note: 7x7 is a ceiling for this neutral carousel template, not a mandatory footprint. A future original design may use 4x4, 5x5, 6x6 or 7x7 if that size produces the best result.

referenceScale.purpose: Upper-bound dimensional reference only. Final geometry must be uniformly scaled/re-authored after the design-time footprint is chosen.

canopy.note: These are upper-bound reference dimensions, not a forced 7x7 design. Segment count is construction topology only and does not prescribe stripes, colors, patterning or ornamentation.

centralColumn.note: Exact visual treatment, height and crown/top geometry must be redesigned from scratch for the selected footprint.

outerSupports.note: Count and radius are neutral mechanical reference values only and may be adjusted with the new design.

rideMounts.note: Mount count and spacing are a neutral mechanical reference only. Vehicle/animal shape is intentionally undefined and dimensions must follow the selected footprint.

boardingAccess.note: Optional functional access zone only; previous stair/rail appearance is not inherited.

nextDesignRule: Create a new original City Horizon carousel from this neutral geometry. Resolve footprint during design based on believable scale and gameplay readability, with 7x7 as the maximum for this template rather than a mandatory size. Do not reuse the rejected V1-V5 visual identity or reference-derived decorative composition.
